name: history
prompt:
Use case: historical-scene
Primary request: Historical reconstruction of the late-19th-century English Lake District: a shepherd/foot hunter in period rural clothing with two hounds and a small wire-haired Lakeland-type terrier moving through a rocky green hillside.
Scene/backdrop: Lake District fells, rocky hillside, natural low vegetation, distant layered hills.
Lighting/mood: atmospheric outdoor light, purposeful but peaceful walk through the landscape.
Constraints: no weapons, no violence, no prey, no hunting action.
Asset type: standalone illustration for a Russian Lakeland Terrier breed website.
Style/medium: beautiful editorial painted illustration, clearly a painting with visible gouache brush texture, sophisticated saturated forest greens and warm ochre, natural anatomy, cinematic composition.
Composition/framing: wide landscape 3:2 image, a single coherent scene with readable subjects, no collage.
Dog appearance: small compact Lakeland-type terrier about 37cm at shoulder, narrow athletic chest, long legs relative to body, rectangular head, small V-shaped ears folded forward, wiry wheaten/reddish coat, little beard, dark expressive eyes, natural tail.
Constraints: no text, no lettering, no logos, no watermark, no UI. Anatomically correct dogs with four legs. Do not make the terrier a huge Airedale, a schnauzer, or a curly doodle.
